authenticated_mongo.role_qualification: Existing named-resource compatibility fixture envelope, not a production minimum-role claim

boundaries: real backend authority, not frontend hiding
ADMIN-only management; canonical owner role reused
current account, accepted invitation proof and membership
publication-time server snapshot; no arbitrary recipients
library/account/notification ownership; revocation hides new private copies
concurrent distinct admins and stale edit revisions
partial write/cursor-ack failure replay and ten-attempt exhaustion
plain text, enums, bounded input and pagination
fresh canonical notification routes; spoofed URLs rejected
original RAG manifest, exact qa.py and executable/transport guards retained
limitations: Finite test corpus is not a universal security proof.
Plain-text checks cannot detect every human-written secret.
